description: Confirmation numbers (docs/40 §16.2): SHA-256("nexusinbox-confirm-v2\n" + smaller root + "\n" + larger root); bytes 0-8 and 9-17, each big-endian mod 10^20 as 20 digits, joined: 40 digits in groups of 5. The same either way round. 40 digits so that a server swapping both roots at first contact cannot find a pair that matches (about 10^20 tries each side). Shared by core and the gateway.
